input.summary: V02 Tungabhadra Actives LLP (contact Anand) sent quotation and COA for RFx KPC-2026-014. Quote is attached; a footnote is mentioned but its content is not in the record. Open: RM-001 quoted per drum with no net weight and MOQ 2 drum (cannot convert to kg); RM-003 COA dated 2026-03-10 is over 6 months old. Knockout questionnaire gaps outstanding: H1 SDS, H2 cosmetic suitability, B5 batch COA, F3 2-8 C cold chain. Asked for other gaps: I1 OTIF, G2 rejection rate, E3 need-by, D2 Incoterm, C4 net weight and pack sizes. Vendor has not yet responded to these. No promises made.

input.subject: KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on quotation (RM-001, RM-003) and outstanding documents
input.body:
Dear Anand,

Thank you for your quotation and COA for KPC-2026-014. We need the following before we can evaluate your offer.

Open items
1. RM-001 Propanediol (bio-based): your quote is per drum with no net weight. Please state the net kg of material per drum (for example, 1 drum = 200 kg net).
2. RM-001 Propanediol: the MOQ of 2 drums must be stated in kg of net material.
3. RM-003 Niacinamide: the COA attached is dated 10 March 2026, which is more than 6 months old. Please provide a current COA for the batch you would supply, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date.
4. Please also explain the footnote referred to in your quotation, as it affects our evaluation.

Mandatory documents and confirmations
5. Current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each line, including transport hazard class.
6. Confirm that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
7. A COA from a recent batch for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date.
8. Confirm you can deliver with an unbroken 2-8 °C cold chain, and describe packaging and temperature logging.

Other information
9. Your on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with your definition of on-time.
10. Your rejection rate for these lines over the last 12 months, stating the period and basis used.
11. Can you meet the first need-by date of 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date.
12. The Incoterm and delivery point, and whether freight, insurance and packing are included. If not, state the amounts.
13. Are quoted weights net of packaging? List the available pack sizes and pack material.

Please reply by 8 November 2026, the response deadline in the RFx.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
